policy_prompt_for_subgoal: Start in A: with the execution-start gripper empty, pick up the cube of the color named in the goal, pointing at its current visible center. Use only the execution scene for this pickup, not its earlier demonstration location. If the observed execution interval shows descent to that cube, closure to a grasp-sized opening (approximately 46%), and a lift with that opening maintained, choose B, dropping onto the target selected by pre_press_target. Explicit held-object evidence also permits B. The recorded cube coordinates may remain at the tabletop position after pickup and a held label may be absent; these do not override the closure-and-lift evidence. Match the remembered point to the corresponding visible target and point within that target, or use the remembered point if it is occluded. If pickup clearly closed on nothing or left the hand empty, choose A again at the requested cube. C is not required: the demonstration press identifies the desired target, and must not be reenacted. A completed release of the requested cube onto the selected target finishes the task; do not press the button afterward. For an otherwise unmatched nonterminal situation, choose B if there is credible evidence the requested cube is held, otherwise A at that cube. If pre_press_target is unknown and dropping is necessary, use the visible target nearest the requested cube as a deterministic fallback rather than asking for clarification.

fields.name: pre_press_target
fields.description: When memory is empty and the demonstration is shown, locate the button press by the closed gripper descending onto the button and its depression. Find the instruction's cube's last completed target placement before that event; if the cube is hidden during the press, use its preceding release and resting position. Match that target to the execution-start scene and write its visible center as [y, x]. Ignore subsequent cube placements when selecting the target. Once populated, copy the incoming value unchanged at every decision step; do not replace it with the cube's current position or a newly shifted visible centroid. If no target can be identified, write "unknown". e.g. [126, 145]
